office_does: The treasurer collects property and excise taxes and acts as the bank for the county and its districts: investing, disbursing and accounting for their money.
race_blurb: Uncontested open seat: Treasurer Tammy Peterson did not file; Chief Deputy Treasurer Marissa Longtain (Prefers Independent Party) is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: The Treasurer's Chief Deputy and Investment Officer, running for the open seat unopposed.
highlights: Chief Deputy Treasurer and Investment Officer [S3]
Presented the county Finance Committee report in August 2026 [S6]
